Class ComponentsImpl

Object
ComponentsImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Components
public class ComponentsImpl extends Object implements Components
Public singleton implementation class of interface Components that holds other singleton component objects as singleton instances. Class provides public getter methods to component instances.
